builds.title: AmberX: hands-free listening on screen + in background, ActiveX-style detection overlay (level graph, dB, quick settings)
builds.detail: Brett, Oct 27 2026 (claude.ai): 'It only detects words when I press speak' in AmberX (apps/amberx-droid). Cause: the native wake listener runs only while 'Watch axHub in the background' is on (default off) and pauses while the app is on screen. Fix: hands-free listening is its own setting (default on), works on screen and in the background, independent of axHub monitoring; optional always-armed (no wake phrase). Plus a detection overlay like ActiveX: floating draggable window over other apps with a moving audio-level line graph, decibel number, what was heard, and quick settings (listening on/off, always armed, hide).
